segs.en: Implement a uniform generator of pseudo-random pairs of integers ($$$a$$$, $$$b$$$) such that $$$1 \le a \le b \le k$$$. Explanation: each valid pair should be generated with equal probability upon each call to the generator.

zh.ai: 实现一个均匀生成伪随机整数对($$$a$$$、$$$b$$$)的生成器，使得 $$$1 \le a \le b \le k$$$。说明：生成器每次被调用时，每个有效的整数对都应以相同的概率生成。

segs.en: The first line of the input contains an integer $$$k$$$ ($$$2 \le k \le 10^9$$$).

zh.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$k$$$($$$2 \le k \le 10^9$$$)。

segs.en: The second line contains an integer $$$n$$$ — the number of pairs to generate ($$$1 \le n \le 10000$$$).

zh.ai: 第二行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$ — 要生成的数对数量 ($$$1 \le n \le 10000$$$)。

segs.en: Using the created generator, generate and output $$$n$$$ pairs. Output each pair on a separate line, separate elements of pairs with a space.

zh.ai: 使用已创建的生成器，生成并输出 $$$n$$$ 对。每对占一行，每对中的元素用空格分隔。

segs.en: When checking solutions, it will be checked whether the resulting sample follows a uniform distribution law over the interval of acceptable values. No other quality checks of your generator will be performed.

zh.ai: 在检查解答时，将检查生成的样本是否在可接受值的区间上服从均匀分布。不会对你的生成器进行其他质量检查。

segs.en: You may know that in the 17th century, a group of Dutchmen founded a settlement called New Amsterdam on Manhattan Island that later went on to become New York City. Less well-known is the story of another group of Dutchmen that also moved over to America and founded a city called New Delft. Like its bigger counterpart, New Delft has been built on a grid made up of two sets of parallel streets that meet each other at a perpendicular angle.

zh.ai: 你可能知道，17世纪，一群荷兰人在曼哈顿岛上建立了一个名为新阿姆斯特丹的定居点，后来这里发展成了纽约市。鲜为人知的是，另一群荷兰人也迁居到了美洲，并建立了一座名为新代尔夫特的城市。与它更大的姊妹城市一样，新代尔夫特建在一个由两组相互平行、彼此垂直相交的街道组成的网格上。

segs.en: Some stroopwafel bakeries have already been built in New Delft, but none of the streets have been constructed. Your task is to lay out the grid of streets. For this, you need to decide on an orientation for the grid so that there are two orthogonal directions for the two types of streets. Once the orientation is fixed, you may build arbitrary streets, as long as each of them has one of the two given directions, as shown in Figure J.1. Each street can be traversed in either direction.

zh.ai: New Delft 已经建成了一些 stroopwafel 面包店，但还没有修建任何街道。你的任务是规划街道网格。为此，你需要确定网格的方向，使两类街道分别沿两个相互垂直的方向延伸。确定方向后，你可以修建任意数量的街道，只要每条街道都沿给定的两个方向之一，如图 J.1 所示。每条街道都可以沿任一方向通行。

segs.en: The street layout should be created in an optimal way for the annual Stroopwafel Run. This is an event in which a group of runners visits all the bakeries in some order of their choosing, and they may start and end their run at any point in the city. Your task is to come up with a grid layout that makes this shortest path as short as possible.

zh.ai: 街道布局应以最优方式设计，用于一年一度的 Stroopwafel Run。这项活动中，一群跑者会按照自行选择的顺序访问所有面包店，并且可以在城市中的任意位置开始和结束跑步。你的任务是设计一个网格布局，使这条最短路径尽可能短。

segs.en: One line with an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 12$$$), the number of stroopwafel bakeries in New Delft.

zh.ai: 一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$2 \le n \le 12$$$)，表示新代尔夫特的荷兰焦糖华夫饼店数量。

segs.en: $$$n$$$ lines, each with two integers $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ ($$$0 \le x,y \le 10^6$$$), the coordinates of one of the bakeries.

zh.ai: $$$n$$$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $$$x$$$ 和 $$$y$$$($$$0 \le x,y \le 10^6$$$)，表示一家面包店的坐标。

segs.en: Output the length of the shortest possible path that visits all bakeries in some order, assuming an optimal grid layout.

zh.ai: 输出在网格布局最优的情况下，按某种顺序访问所有面包店所需的最短路径长度。

segs.en: Your answer should have an absolute or relative error of at most $$$10^{-6}$$$.

zh.ai: 你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差应不超过 $$$10^{-6}$$$。
